prompt: Create a Python 3.12 reservation application managing customers and rooms. A customer can make multiple reservations. A room cannot have two overlapping reservations. Provide CRUD operations and reject reservations that overlap an existing reservation.

intentions.text: I can create a new reservation for a customer in a room.
intentions.requires: a customer ID, room ID, start date, end date
intentions.observable: A confirmation message indicating the reservation was created successfully.

intentions.text: I can retrieve a list of all existing reservations.
intentions.observable: A list of all reservations, including customer ID, room ID, start date, and end date.

intentions.text: I can update an existing reservation's start or end date.
intentions.requires: a reservation ID, new start date, new end date
intentions.observable: A confirmation message indicating the reservation was updated successfully.

intentions.text: I can delete an existing reservation.
intentions.observable: A confirmation message indicating the reservation was deleted successfully.

intentions.text: I can check if a new reservation overlaps with an existing one and be rejected if it does.
intentions.requires: a customer ID, room ID, start date, end date
intentions.observable: A rejection message indicating the reservation overlaps with an existing one.

intentions.text: I can view all reservations for a specific room.
intentions.observable: A list of reservations assigned to that room, including customer ID, start date, and end date.

intentions.text: I can view all reservations for a specific customer.
intentions.observable: A list of reservations made by that customer, including room ID, start date, and end date.
